display_name.description: A short name or phrase used to identify the policy in dashboards, notifications, and incidents.
display_name.rationale: Display metadata with no security impact.

combiner.description: How to combine the results of multiple conditions to determine if an incident should be opened.
combiner.rationale: Logic combiner is a functional setting; the security value comes from the conditions themselves, not the combiner.

conditions.description: A list of conditions for the policy.
conditions.rationale: Conditions are application-specific and cannot be enforced generically via policy.

enabled.description: Whether or not the policy is enabled.
enabled.rationale: A disabled alert policy will not fire under any circumstances, silently eliminating detection and response capability. This creates a blind spot in security monitoring.

notification_channels.description: Identifies the notification channels to which notifications should be sent when incidents are opened or closed.
notification_channels.rationale: Whether channels are configured does not affect whether incidents are detected and recorded; their absence is an operational gap, not a security vulnerability.

user_labels.description: User-supplied key/value data for organizing the AlertPolicy objects.
user_labels.rationale: Organisational metadata with no security impact.

documentation.description: Documentation that is included with notifications and incidents related to this policy.
documentation.rationale: Operational documentation with no security impact.

alert_strategy.description: Control over how this alert policy's notification channels are notified.
alert_strategy.rationale: Operational timing setting with no direct security impact.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Organisational field, not a security control.
